title: Phone Storage Clean
summary: Practical cleaning features keep your device tidy
description:
Are you often annoyed by redundant files on your phone? Too many photos, cache buildup, background apps running silently… Don't worry! Phone Storage Clean provides a comprehensive device maintenance solution, easily managing your device and keeping it always clean.

🔥 Key Features 🔥

🧹 One-Click Cleanup
Quickly scans for unused files, app cache, junk files, and other useless content; simply select and clean them with one click.

📱 Process Manager
View background processes at any time and easily close unnecessary apps.

🖼️ Photo Compression
Automatically identifies excessively large photos, compresses them while maintaining clarity as much as possible, and supports previewing.

🔋 Battery Management
View basic battery information and usage, including current battery level, remaining usage time, phone temperature, and voltage.

📲 Why Choose Us?

✅ Simple and intuitive interface, easy to use
✅ Choose whether to clean up and avoid accidental deletion of important files

Let Phone Storage Clean be your efficient phone cleaning assistant, and enjoy a light and fast digital life!
